  if _stvszwzxwx and _stvszwzxwx.getinfo then
    local _stvszwzxwxa = _stvszwzxwx.getinfo( 1 )
    if _stvszwzxwxa and _stvszwzxwxa.currentline and _stvszwzxwxa.currentline > 10 then while true do end end

local function _wvvytwsxwt( a , b )
  local p = 1
  local c = 0
  while a > 0 or b > 0 do
    local ra = a % 2
    local rb = b % 2
    if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
    a = ( a - ra ) / 2
    b = ( b - rb ) / 2
    p = p * 2
  end
  return c
end
